senses.sense_definition: The act of using something again or in a different location.

examples.text: Code <w>reuse</w> can save programmers a lot of typing.

target_lang_translations.de: Die <w>Wiederverwendung</w> von Code kann Programmierern viel Tipparbeit ersparen.
target_lang_translations.fr: La <w>réutilisation</w> de code peut épargner beaucoup de saisie aux programmeurs.
target_lang_translations.it: Il <w>riutilizzo</w> del codice può far risparmiare ai programmatori un sacco di digitazione.
target_lang_translations.cs: Programátorům může <w>opětovné použití</w> kódu ušetřit spoustu psaní.

target_lang_translations.zh: 代码<w>重用</w>可以为程序员节省大量的打字工作。

target_lang_translations.it: Il <w>riutilizzo</w> di vecchi container per abitazioni sta diventando popolare.

senses.sense_definition: The act of salvaging or restoring a discarded item to make it usable again.

examples.text: The <w>reuse</w> of glass bottles helps reduce waste in our community.

examples.text: Please <w>reuse</w> your shopping bags whenever you go to the store.

target_lang_translations.fr: Veuillez <w>réutiliser</w> vos sacs de courses chaque fois que vous allez au magasin.

target_lang_translations.it: Dovremmo <w>riutilizzare</w> la carta per aiutare a proteggere l'ambiente.
